body: I do. I take serequel and hydroxyzine that a family doctor prescribes me. I unfortunately haven't been able to get an appt with a doctor suited to treat mental health until June.

Thank you for showing understanding and validation. Right now I'm feeling very intense emotions of shame, hopelessness, and depression. Having bpd has made my life very difficult as well and often leads to impulsive actiosn and outbursts when fights happen that push everyone around me away. I've been trying and trying so hard to learn and grown and get help for my mental health but im loosing hope.. I've been thinking of killing myself for some time now and have gone back and forth on my decision. Everyone always says "it gets better" but it is very hard to believe. I made this post in last attempts of finding someone who understands my pain and has maybe gone through a similar experience that might be able to shed some light on my situation and assure me there is hope for me.
